title: MT61324: Welding Of Steels
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Scope and classification of welding Description of welding
processes (including advanced welding techniques), operating characteristics
Physics of welding; Heat and mass transfer Metallurgical principles of welding
Metallurgical effects of the weld thermal cycles. Weldability; effect of
process parameters Welding of steels including low carbon and low alloy steels,
austenitic steels, special steels Residual welding stresses and stress
relieving treatments Mathematical modeling in welding Welding defects and their
remedies. Inspection and testing of weldments Welding codes
